mapper.select: SELECT DATE( `time` ) AS `date`, ROUND(SUM(seconds) / 60, 0) AS minutes FROM read_log WHERE `time` BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND deleted = 1 GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date`

SELECT ROUND( seconds / 60, 0 ) AS minutes id, book_id, modifiable_name as book_name time, FROM read_log JOIN book ON read_log.book_id = book.id AND book.deleted = 1 JOIN files ON book.files_id = files.id AND files.deleted = 1 WHERE `time` BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND deleted = 1
